slug: 2024-11-13 Teraco to build 40 MW JB7 data centre at Isando Campus

facts.fact: Teraco operates colocation data centres in South Africa including its Isando Campus in Ekurhuleni (over 16,500 interconnects) and has 228 MW of critical power load across its facilities after JB7; the article gives no opening dates, so as_of is its publication date.

note: JB7 is under construction (completion 2026) and is not a fact.
